title: pkix-ct missing Send+Sync compile-time assertions
description:
pkix_ct::Error does not have compile-time Send+Sync assertions. Every other error type in the workspace (pkix-path, pkix-revocation, pkix-chain, pkix-truststore, pkix-aia, pkix-identity via pkix-chain) has const _: fn() assertions pinning Send+Sync per AGENTS.md non-negotiable #6 / PKIX-2l0v.2.

pkix-ct::Error currently auto-derives Send+Sync (no Rc/RefCell/raw-pointer fields), but without the compile-time assertion a future field addition could silently break the invariant.

What goes wrong if this stays as-is: A future refactor that adds a non-Send or non-Sync field to pkix_ct::Error would not be caught at compile time in this crate. The error would surface downstream when consumers try to move the error across thread boundaries.

Locations:
- /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-ct/src/lib.rs (entire file — no Send+Sync assertion block)
- Compare with /home/mark/PROJECT/PKIX/pkix-path/src/lib.rs lines 4332-4338 (the assertion pattern)
